required_document_corrections.title: Effective pip CA selection is not bound by PIP_CERT alone
required_document_corrections.basis: Submitted environment-name observation contains REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and CURL_CA_BUNDLE; pip 24.0 vendored requests can prefer nonempty values over session.verify set from PIP_CERT. Their values and actual selected file were not observed by the reviewer.
required_document_corrections.required_change: Explicitly remove competing CA environment names or define and bind the effective precedence and allowed CA file identity; retain TLS verification, value confidentiality and unknown-origin residual risk.

required_document_corrections.title: Pre-commit end record cannot contain the final S10 commit outcome
required_document_corrections.basis: S10 writes 10_end.json before staging and commit, but the response table promises the S10 result in that file.
required_document_corrections.required_change: Keep 10_end.json as PRE_COMMIT with S10 pending; place obtained commit rc, timeout, identity and S10/budget outcome in later external evidence and keep outer return separately. Preserve nulls and first failure when results are unavailable.

execution_prerequisite: Freeze runner and outer harness copies, diff, SHA256, argv and cwd for static review before reseal execution approval. This review does not authorize writing or running them.

nonblocking_notes.topic: pip24 Downloading format identifies the supplied Link host, not the redirect destination or independently observed endpoint

records mode uses a dict that can collapse duplicate distribution Name+Version identities; the fixed full pipeline also has env_profile shadowed detection and exact lock comparison, so no whole-procedure false PASS is claimed

answers.Q1: New-generation separation and mapping of six restoration rules are acceptable as a proposal, not identity restoration or execution approval.
answers.Q2: A is conditionally acceptable after N1 and explicit residual-risk choice. B is not mandatory and needs its own fixed bootstrap procedure if selected.
answers.Q3: The four original ENV-P2-02 weaknesses are addressed within static code and submitted evidence scope. Generation-specific wording is appropriate; no universal or installed-runtime correctness claim.
answers.Q4: Runner and outer harness must be frozen and statically reviewed before execution approval; one precheck may remain in the later authorized procedure.
answers.Q5: Two-line v4 binding addendum is acceptable when bound to the exact v4 and later accepted environment artifacts. C4-E does not automatically carry over. Unrecorded files remain a limited observation scope, with execution-relevant unknowns requiring disposition before adoption.
